args.lesson: Bounded STOP. What worked: checking the Discourse categories.json first showed in one FETCH that community.openstreetmap.org has no commercial-work category, so I searched instead of browsing. Only one paid buyer request was found (t/147703, Berlin cycling infrastructure, 2026-09-15). It needs live OSM edits under organised editing through an accountable account, plus a Berlin rider for 360-degree imagery. That is not an offline deliverable. What failed: geospatial community paid work, like WordPress jobs, means work inside live systems or accounts we do not have. Next time: before testing a request channel, check whether the deliverable can be a file handed over without an account on the target platform. This channel seems to have few such requests. This does not show that geospatial demand is absent elsewhere.
